title: 48 Swahili Phrases in 11 Minutes | Learn Swahili for Beginners (Hope)
description:
Learn 48 essential Swahili phrases in 11 minutes - the fun, fast way.
#Swahili #LearnSwahili #LanguageLearning

Every phrase follows the same rhythm: hear it in English, hear it in Kiswahili, then say it out loud with the pronunciation guide. Perfect for beginners, travellers and anyone who wants to speak Swahili with confidence.

WHAT YOU GET
- 8 themed chapters, 48 real-life phrases
- Kiswahili audio from a native voice
- English pronunciation guide for every line
- A brand-new lesson every single day

CHAPTERS
0:07  Hope · Tumaini
1:23  Banking & Money · Benki na Pesa
2:40  Strength · Nguvu
3:56  Positive Life · Maisha Chanya
5:16  Success · Mafanikio
6:35  Asking for Directions · Kuuliza Njia
7:50  Cultural Traditions · Jadi za Kitamaduni
9:20  Travel & Airport · Usafiri na Uwanja wa Ndege

PHRASE LIST

HOPE · Tumaini
• I’m holding on, things will improve. - Nashikilia matumaini, mambo yataboreka.  [NaSHI ki li a MA ta u mpi NIO, maNBO ya taBOreKA.]
• I can breathe again, thanks. - Naweza kupumua tena, asante.  [NaWE za ku puMUa TE na, aSANTE.]
• Hope is back in my day. - Tumaini limeanza tena siku yangu.  [TuMA iNI li me aNZA TE na SI ku yaNgu.]
• We’ll make it, step by step. - Tutafika, hatua kwa hatua.  [Tu taFI ka, HAn tu kwa HAn tu.]
• Today I choose hope, not fear. - Leo nachagua tumaini, si hofu.  [LEO naCHA gua tuMA iNI, si HOFU.]
• Your message gave me strength. - Ujumbe wako ulinipa nguvu na tumaini.  [U JU mbe waKO u liNPIa NUguvu na tuMA iNI.]

BANKING & MONEY · Benki na Pesa
• I want to check my balance now. - Nataka kuangalia salio langu sasa.  [NaTAka kuanGAli-a SAli-o LANgu SAso]
• Can you transfer money to my account? - Unaweza kuhamisha pesa kwenye akaunti yangu?  [UnaWEza kuhamIsha PEsa KWENye aKAunTI yangu]
• What’s the fee for this transaction? - Ada ya shughuli hii ni kiasi gani?  [Ada ya SHughuli hii ni KIAsi gani]
• My card was declined, what happened? - Kadi yangu imekataliwa, imeenda wapi?  [KaDI yangu imekaTaLIwa, iMEenda waPI]
• I need cash withdrawal limits - Nahitaji mipaka ya kutoa pesa benki.  [NaHITEja miPaka ya kuTOa PEsa benKI]
• How do I deposit money today? - Nitaweka pesa benki vipi leo?  [NiTAweka PEsa BENki viPI leo]

STRENGTH · Nguvu
• I need to build my stamina. - Ninahitajika kujenga stamina yangu.  [Na-NA-hi-JI-kwa KU-JEN-ga STA-mi-na YA-ngu.]
• You’re stronger than you think. - Uko na nguvu kuliko unavyofikiri.  [U-ko NA NGU-FU KU-LI-ko U-na-VO-fi-ki-ri.]
• My back is aching, I’m pushing. - Mgongo wangu unauma, naendelea kusukuma.  [MGONgo waNgu U-na-OU-ma, na-DEE-lea KU-su-KU-ma.]
• Take a deep breath, then go. - Pumua kwa nguvu, kisha uende.  [PU-mua kwa NGU-FU, KI-sha u-EN-de.]
• Keep going, even slowly. - Endelea, hata kama ni kwa taratibu.  [EN-de-LE-a, ha-ta ka-ma ni kwa ta-ra-TI-bi.]
• I’m training my legs for tomorrow. - Ninafundisha miguu yangu kwa kesho.  [Na-na-FUN-dhi-sha MI-guu YA-ngu kwa KES-ho.]

POSITIVE LIFE · Maisha Chanya
• Today, I choose calm over chaos. - Leo, naamua utulivu kuliko fujo.  [Le-O, naa-MUA U-TU-LI-VU KU-LI-KO FU-JO.]
• I breathe, then I try again. - Nafanya pumzi, halafu najaribu tena.  [Naa-Fa-ya PU-MZI, ha-la-FU na-JA-RI-BU TE-NA.]
• My morning walk feeds my mind. - Kutembea kwangu asubuhi kunalisha akili yangu.  [Ku-TEM-be-a kwa-MNGU a-SU-BU-HI ku-NA-LI-SHA A-KI-LI ya-MGU.]
• Gratitude makes space in my heart. - Shukrani hufungua nafasi moyoni mwangu.  [Shu-KRA-ni hu-FU-NGA NA-FA-SI MO-YO-NI mwa-MGU.]
• I say no without guilt. - Nasema hapana bila kuhisi hatia.  [Na-SE-ma ha-PA-na bi-la ku-HI-SI HA-TI-a.]
• Small wins still count, for real. - Ushindi mdogo bado huhesabika, kweli.  [U-SHIN-di MDO-go ba-do HU-HE-SAB-I-ka, KWELI.]

SUCCESS · Mafanikio
• I did it, and I earned it. - Nimefanikiwa, na nimejipatia.  [NimefANikiwa, na nimejIPatia.]
• Small steps, big success, today. - Hatua ndogo, mafanikio makubwa, leo.  [HaTAUa doGO, maFAniKiO maKUbu, leo.]
• Keep going, you will reach it. - Endelea, utafika mafanikioni.  [ENdelea, utafIKA maFAniKiOni.]
• One plan, steady effort, results. - Mpango mmoja, juhudi thabiti, matokeo.  [MpanGO mOja, juHUDi THAAbiti, maTAOKEo.]
• I chose discipline over excuses. - Nimechagua nidhamu kuliko visingizio.  [NimeCHagua niDHaMU kuLiko VISingizio.]
• My hard work paid off fast. - Bidii yangu imelipa haraka.  [BiDii yangu iMELipa haRAka.]

ASKING FOR DIRECTIONS · Kuuliza Njia
• How do I get to City Hall? - Ninawezaje kufika ukumbi wa jiji?  [NInaweZaje KUFIKa ukUMBi wa jiJI]
• Is this the right road to downtown? - Hii barabara inaelekea sehemu ya katikati?  [Hii baRaBARA iNAELeKea seHEmu ya kaTIKaTI]
• Can you show me on the street? - Unaweza kunionyesha kando ya barabara?  [UnaweZA kuNIoNyeSHE KA ndo ya baRaBARA]
• Which way should I walk from here? - Nitembee upande gani kutoka hapa?  [NItemBee UPAnDe gani kuTOka haPA]
